a.xlink:title: First of the two bounded VLAN tags (`max = 2` in the source, drawn as two nodes in the paper's graphs); the tag dispatches exactly as Ethernet does.
L4 dispatch keys on (frag_offset, protocol) concatenated - the source's `map(fragOffset, protocol)`, so only first fragments dispatch.
Only IPv4-protocol ARP/RARP has a recognized body.
Second VLAN tag; a third falls to the default - beyond the graph's bound is simply not a recognized sequence.
The VXLAN port is the source's 65535 [sic] - a made-up placeholder that predates the IANA 4789 assignment.
First of the three bounded GRE headers (`max = 3` in the source). Dispatch keys on (K, proto) concatenated - the source's map values 0x16558/0x16559 are (K=1, EtherType).
Third GRE header; a fourth nesting falls to the default - beyond the graph's bound is simply not a recognized sequence. The NVGRE arm stays.
The source's `ethernet2`: the inner (tunneled) Ethernet header, terminal. Same layout as `Ethernet` - reused as a second instance.
